entries.5477993b61bd2c91: It makes bearing products and CVJ axle products, such as CVJs (constant velocity joints) and axle bearings. Domestic production is mainly carried out by the company, with some outsourced to domestic affiliates. Overseas, manufacturing companies there produce using semi-finished products supplied by the company.
entries.597fbba0f2dd6f0b: The company has a high proportion of sales to the automotive market.
entries.5ba7647aa28ca56a: The company is advancing structural business reform under its medium-term management plan 'DRIVE NTN100' Final, launched in April 2024. For the bearings and other business, the company will consolidate bearing operations that had been divided by market into operations by product, and shift to a model that earns revenue by handling OEM and aftermarket business together across automotive, industrial machinery and other fields. For the CVJ axle business, the company plans to strengthen its foundation through design reform, procurement and logistics reform, and business restructuring, and to expand business responding to new demand such as electrification.

entries.7584dc7832e84306: The company has a high proportion of sales to the automotive market.
